      "snippet": "Yes. You should have a separate “database” layer — but in SAS-CCP terms, it must be contracted, verifiable, and fail-closed, the same way the LTM and Artifact planes are.
The right way to think about it
You end up with three planes:

LTM / OS Update Plane (JSON, small, append-only)

deltas, pointers, invariants, boot manifests

optimized for “rehydrate the brain fast”

Artifact Plane (files, potentially large, immutable blobs)

lesson plans, PDFs, HTML bundles, images, zips

indexed by an artifa"
